role: Two lock-protected Sendable singletons bridging live recording state to the AI context: LiveWorkoutBroker (push snapshot per tick plus pull sample provider from WorkoutRecorder, 12 s staleness gate) and LiveHRVBroker (pull provider registered by RRCollector).
types: LiveWorkoutBroker: class — holds latest LiveWorkoutSnapshot, its timestamp and the recorder's samples provider
LiveHRVBroker: class — holds the RRCollector-installed provider closure for LiveHRVSnapshot
toplevel: Static singletons and lock initializers only.

flags.text: LiveHRVBroker.Provider doc says the implementation hops to @MainActor as needed, but the installed provider reads a lock-protected mirror without any actor hop.

units.does: Under the lock, stores the latest live workout snapshot and stamps lastUpdate = now.
Under the lock, stores the recorder's samples-provider closure.
Under the lock, clears snapshot, lastUpdate and samples provider.

flags.text: Doc says clear() is called at stop and on error, but its only caller is WorkoutRecorder.tearDownLiveWorkoutServices (stop path); no error path calls it, so after an aborted start the samples provider stays registered and only the 12 s snapshot gate hides stale state.

units.does: Under the lock, returns the stored snapshot when it exists and was published within the last 12 s, else nil.

branches.effect: false: nil (no workout); true: check age

units.does: Reads the samples provider under the lock and calls it outside the lock, returning the recorder's sample buffer, or [] when no provider is registered.
calls: closure:SamplesProvider installed by WorkoutRecorder.installLiveWorkoutSamplesProvider (WorkoutRecorder+Start.swift:349) returning recorder.samplesView via MainActor.assumeIsolated

flags.text: The broker is Sendable and documented for any context, but the registered provider runs MainActor.assumeIsolated, which traps when currentSamples() is called off the main actor; ContextBuilder documents that context building usually runs off the main actor and AssistantContext.liveWorkoutHRHistoryLines calls currentSamples during rendering, so correctness depends on every caller happening to be on the main actor.

units.does: Stores the provider closure under the lock (replacing any previous one).
Reads the provider under the lock, then calls it outside, returning its LiveHRVSnapshot or nil when none registered/none active.
calls: closure:Provider installed by RRCollector.publishLiveHRVSnapshotsToAssistant (RRCollector+Bindings.swift:333) reading the collector's live HRV mirror
